snippet.title: Everything Is Crab Playtest Trailer - 2025 Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
Everything Is Crab is a top-down, evolution roguelite where you attempt to constantly evolve a basic animal to keep up with the hostile environment. It combines the magic of Spore’s first phases with the structure of modern roguelites such as Vampire Survivors. This trailer was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526710
